title: cardamine raphanifolia subsp. acris
intro: Cardamine raphanifolia subsp. acris, commonly known as a type of wild cress, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and is known to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine raphanifolia subsp. acris include its ability to reduce fever, promote sweating, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in the treatment of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
